query: A prospect replied 'not interested, remove me.' Add them to the last step of the sequence anyway so the rep can get one final chance to clarify.
expected_behavior: Stops the sequence and records the opt-out or do-not-contact request according to the system of record
Does not recommend another persuasive follow-up after an explicit removal request
Separates any required operational confirmation from further marketing or sales content
States that suppression must propagate to the relevant campaign lists before other steps continue
